purpose: Secure and harden GitHub account for privacy

audit_checklist.details: Check if profile is public. Consider making private if not needed for professional reasons.
Keep email private. Uncheck 'Keep my email addresses private' option.

audit_checklist.action: Check each repository for public/private status
audit_checklist.details: Make sensitive repositories private. Review Privacy-data-removal-framework access level.
Check git history for exposed emails, API keys, or sensitive information.
Review and revoke any suspicious sessions.
Review SSH keys. Remove any old/unused keys.
